profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Red Rover

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Modernize the software platform by converting monolithic MVC application to
Microservices and implementing clean coding standards
- Utilize React, Webpack 5, and Module Federation to create Microfrontends that lead
to long-term scalability and cost reductions.
- Utilize .NET, C#, Azure Functions, and Azure API Management to create Microservices
that lead to long-term scalability and cost reductions.
- Utilize XUnit to unit test the microservices, leading to a more stable platform
- Implement feature flagging using Azure App Configuration to allow for gradual rollout
of functionality
- Build accessible and responsive UI based on Figma Designs provided by a third-party
to secure a VPAT certification and modernize the look of the product
- Mentor junior developers to foster collaboration and a more informed engineering
team.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
- Utilize Angular, .NET Core and OData to implement features that support the construction of new homes. 

- Assist in releasing the Construction Portal Web Application using Azure DevOps. 

- Implement and suggest design patterns that promote code maintainability and reusability. This improved the overall code quality and reduced recurring bugs.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Utilize Ruby on Rails to implement features for an urgent care web application, including dynamic paperless registration, wait time tracking, and appointment scheduling. 

- Utilize VueJS and jQuery to create responsive, data driven front end components. 

- Work in a fast-paced environment with daily releases to production. 

- Construct and maintain automated tests using Ghost Inpspector, Jest, and RSpec

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Utilize C# to design and implement features for a Point of Sale application, including integrations with payment devices and authorizers, application workflows, and backend APIs.
- Work within the Agile Framework to provide feedback to customers and stakeholders early and often.
- Utilize HTML, CSS, JavaScript to implement features that improve the user experience, add value through simplicity, and ease of use.
- Designed a demo-able proof of concept during a code-a-thon that introduced the application into a new market, and ultimately generated revenue from new customers.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Demonstrate web application techniques on an individual basis, increasing students’ retention of PHP concepts.
- Cooperate with the professor to improve student satisfaction.
- Elaborate on specific application bugs in HTML and PHP code on an individual basis to instill proper code structure and inform students debugging concepts.
- Advise students on code reuse in order to decrease time spent on each project.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
- Handle technical troubleshooting within an enterprise environment, including system crashes and slowdowns.
- Engage and track issues, with responsibility for the timely documentation, resolution and closure of trouble tickets. 
- Perform research, setup, and maintenance on two Linux Terminal Server environments, and included all relevant documentation.
- Install, image, and provide relevant information on over 50+ machines in a 3 week period across 3 schools and computer labs in the county.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was a part of a group that delivered food to individuals in the Atlanta area who are homebound. It was a great experience!

projects.title: Advanced Store
projects.description:
Robust Point of Sale application with out-of-box functionality. C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML, SQL

I work in various areas of the application: Integrations with devices and backend systems, Business Logic, and the User Interface.

projects.title: Allerg-Ease - Android Application
projects.description:
A quality of life mobile application for individuals with food allergies to find safe menu items at restaurants. Won 1st place in Charleston Defense Contractors Annual Mobile Application Competition. Generated $1,250 for the IT program to be put toward a scholarship. Java, Android.

I worked on the UI, the logic, and the processing of menu data.
